quests.title: The Strip Outside Emu Plains
quests.blurb: A metre of dirt between the fence and the footpath at Emu Plains, dead for 13 years and not dead now. Council mows on the fifteenth and does not know what is in it. Stand near it and stop the man with the whipper snipper.

steps.label: the strip, which is a garden now
the man with the whipper snipper
photograph it while it still exists

quests.title: Night Fill, Schofields
quests.blurb: Ten to six, nobody in the building but us and a radio that gets one station. Somebody has been taking things and they know our roster, which means they come in off the late train at Schofields.

steps.label: come in on the late one like they do
the loading door nobody watches
whoever is standing in it at two in the morning
$58 of what they took, back

quests.title: The Window Above Macdonaldtown
quests.blurb: I live above the platform at Macdonaldtown and I know this line by sound. Something in the rhythm changed about a month ago and everyone I tell thinks I am mad. Ride it and tell me whether I am mad.

steps.label: ride it and listen to the joins
photograph the stretch that sounds wrong
tell me I am not mad

quests.title: Setting Up at Epping
quests.blurb: Five in the morning at Epping, in the dark, unloading a van by feel. The bloke in the next bay has started arriving at four to take half my frontage. I need a witness and I need them at four.

steps.label: the bays, at the hour it happens
the bloke with the extra trestle
you will want one at that hour
$53 of frontage, recovered

quests.title: The Clock at Sefton
quests.blurb: The clock on the Sefton platform has been four minutes fast since I got here and every relief who comes through wants to fix it. Do not fix it. Find out who set it that way, before they retire.

steps.label: the clock, four minutes fast, for the file
to Chester Hill, where the old crew drink
bring the name back

quests.title: The Dog at Castle Hill
quests.blurb: A dog meets the 5:40 at Castle Hill every weekday and nobody gets off for it. Four months of this. I have decided it is not going to be a sad story. Find out whose it is.

steps.label: the end of the platform, at twenty to six
the street it walks home to
tell me it is not a sad story

quests.title: The Book at Cabramatta
quests.blurb: Up four hundred over eleven weeks on the Cabramatta delay market. You cannot beat a delay book unless you can see the roster, and it has been like that since the merge. Think about who can see the roster.

steps.label: ride the run they ride
the two who follow you off it
$52 back off the book

quests.title: Last Service out of Burwood
quests.blurb: The last one through Burwood carries four people and one of them is always asleep. Ride it to Strathfield, photograph the platform with nobody on it, and come back and tell me the place still exists when there is no one in it.

steps.label: ride the late one to Strathfield
the empty platform, lit and pointless
tell them what you saw

quests.title: The Wiley Park Tap-Off
quests.blurb: A card ending 15 boards at Wiley Park on grand final week and vanishes. Not a fare thing — ninety cents. I want to know *how*, and nobody upstairs wants to hear it.

steps.label: ride the run the card rides
the gap in the fence everyone knows about
photograph it before somebody welds it

quests.title: The Flemington Order
quests.blurb: Two hundred coffees out of Flemington before twenty past four and I know every one of them by the walk. The relief driver stopped coming three weeks back. Take one over to where they work and find out whether I lost them to the chain up the road.

steps.label: order one at the Flemington kiosk
the office they walk to, or used to
come back with $42 — I am not running a charity

quests.title: Four Minutes at Windsor
quests.blurb: The board at Windsor says four minutes. It has said four minutes since before the merge and it is a lie about a third of the time. Stand under it, time it, and bring me numbers instead of feelings.

steps.label: stand under the board and wait like everyone else
photograph the board saying four minutes
ride the one that finally comes
give me the number

quests.title: Unclaimed at Oatley
quests.blurb: Everything anyone leaves on the Oatley line ends up in a room and the room is full. Nine hundred umbrellas and one a clipboard nobody signed with a name on it and a number that rings out. Go to the address on the tag.

steps.label: the address on the tag
the two who got there before you
$45 — whatever it is, it is worth that to somebody

quests.title: The Quiet Carriage, Westmead
quests.blurb: Speakerphone. Grand final week, Westmead to town, speakerphone. I have made eye contact eleven times and it has achieved nothing.

steps.label: ride the quiet carriage and observe the crime
apply the shame manually
photograph the sign, for the record

quests.title: The Rozelle Bay Shortcut
quests.blurb: Nine minutes between the shortcut at Rozelle Bay and the long way, and nine minutes is four drops. Since the week of the show there has been a padlock on it, and they keep sending a different bloke.

steps.label: the end they lock
the long way round, so you understand what it costs
$72, which is what the long way costs me a week

quests.title: Possession at Glenfield
quests.blurb: Third time at Glenfield on the long weekend. Not kids — kids run. This one walks, and I have run out of ways to say it politely. I need it stopped before somebody writes a very long report about me.

steps.label: where they come through the fence
the ones who think a hard hat is a costume
photograph the gap so I can put a number on the form
